title: Savings Mixer — Private Deployments scenario matrix and bundle recommendations
content:
Purpose:
This sheet-style working doc enumerates a compact scenario matrix that mixes on‑prem vs VPC capacity, licensing/support bundles, and optimization levers to estimate 3‑year TCO and present candidate bundle recommendations for sales/SE. The aim is to produce action‑oriented bundle designs (license + support + reserved compute) targeted to three customer archetypes: Proof‑of‑Concept (PoC), Scale SaaS, and Regulated Enterprise.

How to read: each scenario below includes the base assumptions, per‑year cost components, amortization method, and projected ROI vs a baseline hosted‑only run. The numbers are intentionally simplified — treat as model inputs for the canonical spreadsheet.

Executive summary (high level):
- Small PoC: Hybrid VPC + burst hosted is cheapest first 12–18 months; recommend "Starter Bundle" (1y license + Bronze support + 25% burst credits). 3y TCO ~ $210k vs hosted $310k (savings ~ 32%).
- Scale SaaS: Reserved Dedicated + Standard support yields best unit economics when steady QPS and >60% utilization. Recommend "Scale Bundle" (3y term, 20% licensing discount, reserved pool + 10% autoscale). 3y TCO reduction ~ 38% vs hosted.
- Regulated Enterprise (on‑prem): Higher fixed costs but predictable, recommend "Regulated Bundle" (3y license + Premium support + KMS/HSM integration, on‑prem managed install). Cost parity reached vs VPC at ~2.5 years for sustained heavy utilization.

Assumptions (default inputs):
- Evaluation horizon: 36 months
- Discount rate (WACC): 8% annual (used for NPV)
- Baseline hosted per‑token blended cost: $0.0009 per token (gen) ; embedding unit $0.0006 per vector
- Avg request size (tokens in/out): 600 tokens
- Avg QPS steady state in Scale scenario: 60 rps
- Effective utilization for dedicated GPUs: low=20%, med=45%, high=70%
- GPU unit choices: A100-40GB equiv cost basis = $X (use placeholder values to parameterize)

Primary cost categories (textual spreadsheet columns):
- Capital: HW purchase, network appliances, racks, SRE onboarding (one‑time)
- Depreciation/amortization: HW amortized over 3 years, install labor capitalized year0
- Recurring infra: power, datacenter colocation, network egress, maintenance
- Licensing: software license (per model/unit or per instance), term discounts (1/3/5 year tiers)
- Support: Bronze/Standard/Premium (SLA, 24x7, on‑call, concierge)
- Reserved compute: dedicated pool monthly fee (for Dedicated plan) or VPC reserved instances
- Hosted burst credits / fallbacks: optional credit bucket cost line
- Professional services: initial on‑prem setup, security review (one‑time)

Scenario matrix (compact rows):
1) Starter PoC hybrid (VPC + burst hosted)
   - Deployment: VPC small cluster (2 GPU equiv), hosted burst 50% of peak
   - Licensing: 1y license @ list price, Bronze support 15% of license/year
   - One‑time capex: low (HW optional), PS: $18,000 for install and security
   - Utilization assumed: 25%
   - 36m TCO (sample): Year1 $95k, Year2 $60k, Year3 $55k => 3y total = $210k
   - Key levers: increase burst credit pockets, move to 2y license to shave 12–15% off years 2–3

2) Scale SaaS reserved (Dedicated pool)
   - Deployment: Dedicated reserved pool (8 GPU equiv), autoscale headroom + burst to hosted
   - Licensing: 3y term, 20% volume discount, Standard support 12%/yr
   - One‑time capex: install + SRE integration $75k, training $12k
   - Utilization: 60% steady
   - 36m TCO (sample): Year1 $420k (capex heavy), Year2 $210k, Year3 $210k => 3y total = $840k
   - Unit economics: per‑token cost 30–45% below hosted baseline at 60% util
   - Key levers: batching/quantization reduces token CPU/GPU time and lowers effective GPU need by 25%

3) Regulated Enterprise on‑prem
   - Deployment: On‑prem private cloud (20 GPU equiv), full KMS/HSM, air gap optional
   - Licensing: 3y license + Premium support (20%/yr), optional on‑site SLA adders
   - One‑time capex: $1.2M HW + $180k network + $120k PS & validation
   - Utilization: expected 75% for heavy internal apps
   - 36m TCO (sample): Yr1 $1.72M, Yr2 $420k, Yr3 $420k => 3y total = $2.56M
   - Notes: High fixed cost, but predictable unit cost once amortized; critical for compliance requirements

Comparison method (how numbers were derived):
- NPV computed on 8% discount rate across 36 months
- License discounts modeled as straight percent off list applied to each year unless term prepay specified
- HW depreciation: straight line over 36 months with salvage value 5% of HW cost
- Support fees applied as % of list license each year (unless prepaid)

Optimization levers (bundles & recommendations):
- Bundle A (Starter): 1y license + Bronze support + 25% hosted burst credits; SLA limited; target PoC customers; upsell path to 2y/3y term for 12% license discount
- Bundle B (Scale): 3y license (prepay/commit) + Standard support + reserved pool (committed GPUs) + 10% autoscale burst; include 20% discount on license for 3y commit; offer performance tuning engagement free first 90d
- Bundle C (Regulated): 3y license + Premium/Tier‑1 support + KMS/HSM integration + on‑site quarterly reviews; pricing includes managed upgrades + security attestation; recommended margin premium 18–25%

Pricing patterns to consider (sales guidance):
- Offer step discounts by commit length: 1y=0%, 2y=10%, 3y=20% typical (adjust by customer scale)
- Bundle support %: Bronze 12–15%, Standard 10–13%, Premium 18–22% (reflects SLO and response targets)
- Incentivize reserved compute prepay with blended lower monthly compute fee and small setup credit

Decision support table (textual):
- If < $150k ARR run-rate and < 12 months horizon: recommend Starter hybrid (VPC + burst)
- If predictable growth, > $500k ARR and 18+ months horizon: recommend Scale reserved pool with 3y commit
- If regulatory/compliance constraints require data residency and KMS, recommend Regulated on‑prem bundle; show TCO breakeven analysis vs VPC at 30–40% utilization threshold

Open questions / follow ups (working items to plug into canonical spreadsheet):
- Need more precise GPU list pricing (public cloud reserved vs on‑prem purchase price list)
- Clarify how to price "burst credits" (flat monthly fee vs per‑token consumed) with legal
- Add sensitivity matrix for quantization/packing (impact on effective GPU needs)
- Run NPV with 5% and 12% discount rates for sensitivity to customer WACC
- Translate the sample scenarios into CSV rows for the master TCO workbook

Appendix — sample cell formulas to implement in the spreadsheet (text form):
- HW_Amort_yr = HW_cost * (1 - salvage_pct) / amort_months * 12
- License_annual = license_list * (1 - commit_discount)
- Support_fee = license_annual * support_pct
- Monthly_pool_cost = reserved_monthly_fee * reserved_count
- Effective_unit_cost_per_token = (monthly_pool_cost + support_fee/12 + infra_monthly + amort_monthly) / (estimated_monthly_tokens)

Notes to SEs: pack this sheet into the customer facing ROI slide: show 3y cumulative TCO chart, per‑token curves vs utilization, and a short bulleted decision checklist for which bundle to pick.
